d:
Fall in love with the evergreen romantic duet "Main Teri Rani Tu Raja Mera" from the Bollywood film Lootere (1993). Featuring Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla, this melodious song is beautifully sung by the iconic duo Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik.
